test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: When the speed of a truck is increased by 20%, it takes 25 minutes less to cover the same distance. What is the time (in hours) taken to cover twice the distance at its actual speed?
solution:
**Given:**

When the speed of a truck is increased by 20%, it takes 25 minutes less to cover the same distance.

**Concept used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

Let the distance be ‘x’ km and speed be ‘n’ km/minutes

So, increased speed = n × 120%

⇒ 1.2n

According to the question,

(x/n) – (x/1.2n) = 25 

⇒ [(1.2x - x)/1.2n] = 25

⇒ 0.2x/1.2n = 25

⇒ x/n = (25 × 1.2)/0.2

⇒ x/n = 30/0.2

⇒ x/n = 150

Here, ‘x/n’ is the time taken to cover the distance with the original speed.

So, to cover twice its actual distance with its actual speed will take = 150 × 2

⇒ 300 minutes

300 minutes = 5 hours [∵ 1 hour = 60 minutes]

**∴ The time (in hours) taken to cover twice the distance at its actual speed is 5.**
